description: This Java source file defines the PatientSaveHandler class, which implements save handling logic for Patient objects within the OpenMRS project. It ensures that patient identifiers are correctly associated with the patient during save operations.

classes.name: PatientSaveHandler
classes.description: A handler class that manages the save process for Patient objects, ensuring identifiers are linked correctly.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the saving process for a Patient; sets the Patient in each PatientIdentifier if not already associated.
